Restore Zig 0.16.0 as the supported toolchain for stability.

## Changed

- Restore the implementation, build configuration, examples, and tests from
  v0.1.2, before the Zig 0.17 migration.
- Require Zig 0.16.0 for this release. Zig 0.17 is not supported by this version.
- Update dependencies to Chasen v0.1.4, Chasen Anim v0.1.2, and Chasen Graphics v0.1.3.
- Publish the restored implementation as v0.1.4; existing releases remain unchanged.

No new features are added.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen-ui/compare/v0.1.3...v0.1.4
